title: Security & Access Control Rules
authentication_session_identity: Protected operations REQUIRE explicit user authentication via Firebase Authentication using Google and Facebook sign-in providers.
Every protected operation MUST verify user authentication_id and map to a valid User entity and Role.
Public Firebase project config is client metadata, NOT security authorization. Do NOT rely on client config secrecy.
mandatory_data_validation_constraints: Foreign Key Integrity: Reject records referencing non-existent foreign keys.
Enum Restrictions: Reject unapproved enum values.
Non-Negative Quantities: guest_count > 0; monetary amounts >= 0; available_quantity >= 0 (Reject negative stock deductions).
Payment Cap: Total paid amount MUST NOT exceed order total_amount.
Schedule Overlap Rejection: Reject schedule updates that overlap an existing confirmed EventSchedule.
Equipment Verification Constraint: released_quantity == returned_quantity + missing_quantity + damaged_quantity.
historical_data_protection: Backend security rules MUST prohibit UPDATE and DELETE operations on Inventory Movement, Payment Transaction, and Audit Trail.
Customers MUST NOT be granted write permissions on confirmed reservations, customizations, orders, or schedules.
All protected status changes MUST trigger an Audit Trail entry.
privacy_and_credentials: Customer contact details restricted to authorized staff, admins, and owning customer.
Do NOT place private keys, API secrets, or credentials in GitHub Pages or client JS.
